summary: Jenkinsfile.destroy-stage (ArgoCDTools fa32363 on phase/037-P5) is the Destroy Stage pipeline: a guard (registry on main, live argocd-prd Applications single- and multi-source, and a REPO spelled as GitHub spells it), a one-off destroy Job in argocd-hooks on argocd-hook:latest run as destroy-stage, and the config/<stage>/ push on apply; a dry run by default. The declarative linter validates it and kc project test is green. The job IaC/Destroy Stage was created through createItem with no builds; done-record and P6 edits are in AnsibleSpecs 343933c.
